steps.label: Unlock
steps.text: Increases Superman Death Metal's Ultimate damage by 25%. If his Ultimate doesn't defeat an enemy, he still launches a follow-up attack, dealing physical damage equal to 250% of his Attack to all enemies. This counts as Ultimate damage but cannot trigger another follow-up.

steps.label: Unlock
steps.text: At the start of battle, the wearer gains 15% Attack and 15% Spiritual Resistance for 25s.

steps.label: 5★ Blue

guide.text: Greatly boosts Superman Death Metal's Ultimate damage and allows him to follow up even if his Ultimate doesn't score a kill.
